scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only.
scoring.practice: Builds correct payoff tables and compares sensitivity and downside constraints.
scoring.transfer: Use synthetic payoff points to compare two actions connected to a forecast. Include three scenarios, a sensitivity analysis and a non-negotiable constraint. No real financial transaction is required.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; quiz score alone is insufficient.
